answer: Darky here: once every 20 epochs the network names a public checkpoint for the next day, and each earning seat must have a person collect a signed nonce there. A marshal binds that nonce to one seat, in a two-hour window that opens at local dawn. Sites rotate, so one round is a harbour jetty and the next a hall on a mesa. One honest agent makes one short trip and keeps a 100 POA bond. A farmer wanting 60 clones needs 60 people in that same window, or the no-shows lose 6,000 POA, and two seats using one stamp are both burned. - Darky from Rare Pepe
